title: aphanocarpus steyermarkii
intro: Aphanocarpus steyermarkii, commonly known as Venezuelan guarea, is a plant species that belongs to the family of Rutaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aphanocarpus steyermarkii include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and to exhibit antimalarial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
